answers.reason: The dean is a high-ranking office holder who represents the faculty in central university bodies.
The budget planning round allocates funds to faculties, and the dean represents the faculty towards the university leadership.
The dean leads the faculty and is permitted to take part in all bodies at or below the faculty level, especially those affecting the university-wide plan like appointments.
The description explicitly states that the dean chairs the faculty council.
The study commission advises the faculty council, and as head of the faculty, the dean may take part in all bodies below their level.
The examination board is a faculty-level body below the dean's office, and those with a higher office may take part in bodies below their level.
This round awards the faculty's internal grants, placing it within the faculty where the dean holds the highest office and right of participation.
As a working group within a degree programme of the faculty, it sits below the dean's level, allowing the dean to participate by right of higher office.
Choosing equipment for a teaching laboratory is a decision below the dean's level within the faculty, which the dean is permitted to join.
Planning the orientation week for new students is a subordinate task within the faculty, and office holders may take part in all bodies below their level.
